stem:

choiceB: Cretaceous ammonites discarded their inner jaws to accelerate swimming speeds away from predators.
choiceC: Shell fracture resistance in crustaceans increased uniformly throughout the Cretaceous period.
choiceD: Predatory marine reptiles relied entirely on soft-bodied ammonites rather than hard-shelled organisms.
explanation: Главная идея текста заключается в том, что некоторые аммониты развили кальцинированные челюсти для поедания панцирных организмов.

stem:
Economist Dr. Maya Vance investigated the effects of municipal transit fare subsidies on low-wage employment access. She observed that districts offering subsidized commuter passes experienced a 20% rise in job retention rates within two years, provided that local bus scheduling frequencies were maintained.

Which choice best describes the function of the second sentence?
choiceA: It presents empirical findings from Dr. Vance's analysis while identifying a necessary operational condition.
choiceB: It refutes the economic theory of urban transportation networks introduced in the opening paragraph.
choiceC: It compares median public transit operating budgets across different metropolitan areas.
choiceD: It outlines the legislative history of municipal transit fare regulations in major cities.

stem:

stem:
Psychologists tested whether structured creative writing exercises improved emotional regulation among high school adolescents. Students who completed daily journaling tasks scored 25% lower on standardized anxiety inventories after six weeks compared to a control group that performed rote spelling drills. choiceB: Adolescents with high baseline anxiety showed greater score reductions than those with mild baseline symptoms.
choiceC: The control group spent an equivalent number of minutes completing written assignments.
choiceD: Expressive writing improved vocabulary retention scores across all participant subgroups.
explanation: Одновременное участие в психотерапии дает альтернативное объяснение снижению тревожности, что подрывает вывод об исключительной роли ведения дневника.

stem:
Labor market economists evaluated the economic impacts of municipal mandatory sick-leave policies on retail worker productivity. Firms complying with paid leave mandates experienced a 12% drop in unplanned absenteeism within one year. However, net operating profit margins for small retail stores declined by 5% as businesses incurred temporary staffing replacement expenses.

choiceB: Paid sick-leave mandates universally eliminate profitability across all corporate retail sectors.
choiceC: Retail workers utilize paid sick days exclusively for non-health-related recreational activities.
choiceD: Temporary staffing replacement expenses are consistently lower than baseline retail operating revenues.
explanation: Вывод подтверждается обоими фактами исследования: снижением непланируемых прогулов с одной стороны и сокращением маржи прибыли из-за найма временных сотрудников с другой.

stem:

Participants instructed to protect their existing savings from potential erosion saved 28% more money over six months than those instructed to accumulate wealth.
